# Damaris Leigh

## Overview

- **Nicknames:** Mistress Tremayne  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P45](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0045)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [John Tremayne](../character/john-tremayne.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Damaris Leigh presents an agreeable appearance, highlighted by large, bright hazel eyes and a typical English complexion. She is also noted for her abundant, shiny brown hair.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P45](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0045)_

## Personality

Damaris Leigh is skilled in the art of decorating. Her stylistic abilities have been compared to those of Mistress Tremayne, particularly in her capacity to accomplish marvelous design feats.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P4](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0004)_

## History

After her parents died, Damaris Leigh remained in [England](../codex/places.md#england) to care for her ailing uncle out of devotion to him. Following his passing, she endured a terrible voyage to join her betrothed, [John Tremayne](../character/john-tremayne.md), suffering through severe storms and depleted supplies. On the evening she finally arrived, she married John at Captain Saul's house.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P7](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P43](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0043), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P45](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0045)_
